1.why: Body text uses a clean sans-serif with comfortable line height and spacing between blocks, though letter spacing looks near-default and the log panel uses a monospace face.

2.why: No italics, all-caps strings, or dense paragraphs appear on any screen; headings and buttons use sentence case.

3.why: The single narrow column with large inputs and full-width buttons reads clearly at phone width in every screenshot.

4.why: Instructions are one-line plain-language sentences such as 'Get a six-digit identity code for this demo.' and 'Take as long as you need.'

5.why: Input placeholders show the expected format: 'name@example.com' for email and '123456' for the six-digit code.

6.why: The longest text on any screen is two short lines; nothing long must be read to proceed.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard control exists anywhere and the activity log states the identity code is shown only in the browser console, forcing manual transcription.

8.why: No QR code or scannable equivalent is offered on any screen; manual entry is the only path.

9.why: Only plain manual inputs are shown; the console-delivered code cannot be autofilled and no one-time-code or password-manager support is evident, though the standard email/password fields may accept managers.

10.why: Icon-paired headings, a highlighted progress segment, and a dominant filled blue button make the step and action clear, though the progress segments are unlabeled and abstract.

11.why: Each screen presents exactly one filled primary button; 'Re-request identity code' is a visually demoted secondary option.

12.why: Green status banners plainly state what happened and what comes next, e.g. 'Signed in successfully. Next: get your identity code.'

13.why: Retry and 'Re-request identity code' remain available after the error with no penalty, but no reveal/hide control for codes is provided.

14.why: The error 'That code does not match. Check the six digits, or request a new code.' states the problem and two fixes without blaming the user.

15.why: An explicit notice says 'There is no reading timer. Take as long as you need.' and no countdown or timeout appears on any screen.
